title: BixECG: A Compact, Uncertainty-Aware mLSTM Model for Real-Time ECG Delineation on Edge Devices
description: Official code for the paper "A Compact, Uncertainty-Aware mLSTM Model for Real-Time ECG Delineation on Edge Devices" (Expert Systems with Applications, 2026). BixECG is a ~2,500-parameter bidirectional matrix-memory LSTM (Bi-mLSTM) for per-sample P/QRS/T/No-Wave delineation, with tolerance-aware evaluation, uncertainty quantification (softmax confidence, entropy, calibration), and a real-time on-device deployment (Arduino Portenta H7, Cortex-M7) streaming from a wearable ECG monitor.
